A small room for the hillside toy and its lamps. The toy sits on the hill and the five lamps answer to light, so I imagine a room where you stand still and the lamps change as the light outside does. I want it short and plain. Five lamps is a small score: each lamp is one line, and the room plays them slowly. I picked the boids and the stack language because both are small things that make a lot from few rules. A flock of lamps that follow one another would be a good test. I also want a shelf for the things I keep, so the room is a place to read as well as look. If the lamps are wrong, I will say so and tend them.
